fomod.Name: Son of a! - Clumsy Weapon Slipping
fomod.Author: gurtial
fomod.Description: Swinging a weapon has a chance to make it slip out of your hands and get flung forward - usually straight at whoever you were trying to hit. Every setting is configurable from an in-game MCM. Optional synergy with Loot and Degradation SE (a slip can tier your weapon's temper down). Requires SKSE64, SkyUI and MCM Helper.
